blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Delta. Nearest rapid-transit station: Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), the terminus of TransLink Routes 601 and 602 from South Delta.
Nearest bus exchange: South Delta Exchange, on 56 St, served by Routes 601 and 602.
Route 601 Bridgeport Station/South Delta (TransLink): via 12 Ave and 56 St (South Delta Exchange) to Bridgeport Station.
Route 602 Bridgeport Station/Tsawwassen Heights (TransLink): via 56 St (South Delta Exchange) and 12 Ave, through this area, to Bridgeport Station.
South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 Street, Delta: arena, curling rink and gymnasium.
Cliff Drive Elementary, K-7, School District 37 Delta, 5025 12 Ave; catchment not confirmed.
South Delta Secondary, 8-12, School District 37 Delta, 750 53 St; catchment not confirmed.
Southpointe Academy, K-12, School District 37 Delta, 1900 56 St, independent; catchment not confirmed.
Thrifty Foods, 1207 56th Street, Delta (retailer's own store page).
Tsawwassen Mills, 5000 Canoe Pass Way, Delta.

items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Tsawwassen Central name.
Walks from South Delta Recreation Centre: to Tsawwassen Library measured 1.52 km and to Thrifty Foods 1.58 km, both over the 1.5 km walk cap — dropped.

faq.a: No — it is a Paragon sub-area name. The official planning framework is the Tsawwassen community under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), a single consolidated plan, and no official City boundary exists for the name.
faq.q: Is Tsawwassen Central an official City of Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: Yes — the Tsawwassen Urban Centre is a Development Permit Area under the Official Community Plan, with guidelines in Appendix B of Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) covering siting, streetscape, massing and landscaping.
faq.q: Do development rules treat the town centre differently?

faq.a: South Delta Exchange, at 56 Street and 18 Avenue beside South Delta Recreation Centre, is served by routes including 601 to Bridgeport Station and 602 to Tsawwassen Heights and Bridgeport Station.
faq.q: Where do buses leave from in central Tsawwassen?

faq.a: Highway 17 south leads to the BC Ferries Vancouver (Tsawwassen) terminal in Delta; BC Ferries lists sailings from Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay (Victoria), Duke Point and Departure Bay (Nanaimo) and the Southern Gulf Islands.
faq.q: How do you get to the ferry from central Tsawwassen?
